Title: What is the Meeting Room Cancellation and Global Policies
Search text: What is the Meeting Room Cancellation and Global Policies Cancellation Policy Meeting rooms If a customer wishes to cancel their meeting room booking the policy is: If the room is a 1-10 workstation room Full refund when the cancellation is made 10 days or more in advance of the event date. 50% refund when the cancellation is made 5 – 9 days in advance of the event date. No refund will be given for less than 5 days’ notice, if the room size is 10 or less workstations. If the room is a 11-20 workstation room Full refund when the cancellation is made 20 days or more in advance of the event date. 50% refund when the cancellation is made 10 – 19 days in advance of the event date. No refund will be given for less than 10 days prior to the event date, when the room size is 11 or more workstations. If the room is a 21+ workstation room Full refund only when the cancellation is made 20 days or more in advance of the event date. No refund will be given for less than 20 days, when the room size is greater than 21 workstations. If a cancellation is made within 2 hours of the booking creation, cancellation fee is zero. Title: Booking is disabled due to connected inventories
Search text: Booking is disabled due to connected inventories Application / Service Customer Portal Issue Symptoms / Error If the customer claims that booking of the one inventory makes disabled booking of the another inventory by other customers. For example, if the customer wants to book Meeting Room i.e. MR 05 then other centre/centres i.e. MR05+MR06 and MR 06 will be disabled for booking in that period, seems these inventories are connected in some way. Resolution There are steps that need to be checked: Navigate to Titan Navigate to Centre Admin within Admin tab (right upper corner) Search for provided Centre Number (i.e. 5204) within Centre Number field and click “Go” Navigate to Inventory Admin within Admin tab (right upper corner) Select Inventory Type -> Meeting Room Select Inventory Name -> the one that is provided from the customer Scroll to the section Potential Suite/Connecting Rooms Check is there some connected inventory Additional Information Note: If there are some connected inventory/inventories then those Meetings Rooms will be connected to each other, so if the one is already booked, the booking will be disabled for others.

Title: No Internet Connection Error while opening Team Hub
Search text: No Internet Connection Error while opening Team Hub Issue TeamHub shows a “No Internet Connection” error even though the device is connected to Wi-Fi. Cause The error occurs when WLAN data usage for the TeamHub app is disabled in the device’s Wi-Fi settings. When this setting is turned off, TeamHub cannot use the Wi-Fi connection. Resolution Follow these steps to re-enable WLAN data access for TeamHub: Click Start on your device. Search for Wi-Fi settings and open it. Select Choose apps that can use your WLAN data . Find and click TeamHub in the list. Enable WLAN data usage for the app.

All of these email have 2 buttons, Accept Renewal and Decline Renewal. While Accept Renewal button is straight forward and it will just process the renewal, Decline Renewal will terminate the current agreement with the End Date that is set for it. In cases where users are ignoring these email and do not click on anything the following will happen: If the agreement is Auto-Renewing (can be checked on Titan UI) the agreement will renew automatically by NDD date If the agreement is not Auto-Renewing it will become inactive once the End Date is passed. Additional note: If the customer is suspended when the reminder email is set to be sent out (NDD-21), email will not be sent. But if the customer is reinstated before the agreement is supposed to be auto-renewed, agreement will be renewed even if the email was never sent to them. Search text: User cannot find a Service on TeamHub This KB is for when the User wants to add a service on TeamHub, but they cannot find it on the list of Services. For Example, they want to add a 'One off forwarding charge' to the customer, but the service is not on the list. We can check if this information on Titan UI by checking the following steps: 1. Go to the 'Service Pricing' section on Titan UI 2. Select the corresponding Service Catalogue, Service Category and Service Name. The Service Catalogue can be deduced using the attached Excel Sheet 'TeamHub Service Catalogue and Centre ID'. In our case it is the 'US Catalogue'. The Service Category in our case will be 'Mail Handling' and the Service Name is 'One-off mail forwarding charge'. 3. After selecting we will check if the POS column is enabled. In our case we see that it is not, which means that the service is acting as designed since it is not supposed to appear on the service list on TeamHub. If this is the case this is as designed and the customer should contact the Titan Admin team since they are able to make changes if necessary. Thank you for your patience.

Yield management uses demand, price adjustment, inventory, and continuous monitoring to make smart decisions on pricing and availability, based on detailed analysis of customer behavior and market trends, to increase the amount of money made from fixed amount of inventory items, including short stay products. Quark was developed as the tool used to calculate yield management pricing. Search text: Titan: Unable to Move a Booking After the Booking End Date Has Passed Issue When a workstation is being re-terminated, any bookings still attached to it must first be moved elsewhere. If the booking you are trying to move has already ended, the move fails in one of two ways: Selecting Move Entire Booking returns an error stating that the last booking date is still the booking's original end date. This most often appears where two bookings run back to back on the same workstation, with the earlier booking ending one day and the replacement booking starting the very next day. Search text: Why can't I book an office room until 11:59 PM? (Short Stay bookings end at 11:30 PM Title: Why can't I book an office room until 11:59 PM? (Short Stay bookings end at 11:30 PM) Type: FAQ / Expected Behaviour Category: Bookings → Short Stay (Office Rooms) Audience: All customers booking Short Stay office rooms via the Customer Portal Why can't I book an office room until 11:59 PM? When booking a Short Stay office room through the Customer Portal, the latest end time you can select is 11:30 PM. There is no option to select 11:59 PM, which leaves a 30-minute gap between 11:30 PM and midnight (12:00 AM). This is expected behaviour, not a fault — the booking time selector has always worked this way. What you'll see When choosing an end time for a Short Stay office room booking, the last selectable option before midnight is 11:30 PM. If you're booking a period that spans midnight, you'll need two separate bookings — for example: Booking 1: 6:00 PM → 11:30 PM Booking 2: 12:00 AM → 6:00 AM The 30-minute window between 11:30 PM and 12:00 AM cannot currently be selected in the portal. Why this happens The booking time selector is designed to offer end times up to 11:30 PM as the final slot

Title: Randomized MAC address error
Search text: Randomized MAC address error Details If the client or center team is getting this error (screenshot below) while adding the MAC address in Myregus account, that is because Customer portal web and mobile app do not support randomized MAC address. Randomized MAC address masks the identity of the device by creating a different randomized address for each Wi-Fi network (SSID) that a device joins. That address is used only when accessing that particular network, which means it cannot be used to track activity across others. Rather than using your hardware-coded MAC address, your system is recognized through use of the randomized one. As a result, users cannot be tracked from one Wi-Fi network to another. MAC Address Randomization is also used to mask device identity when using location-based services, such as Maps, when making peer-to-peer Wi-Fi connections such as with Airdrop or Airplay, or when using Personal Hotspot or Internet Sharing. This is working as designed. Please advise the customer to check their device for the original MAC address and enter that in Myregus portal. Title: Why the Payment failure Email was not sent to the client?
Search text: Why the Payment failure Email was not sent to the client? Application / Service Customer Portal Details Why the payment failure Email was not sent to the client? Invoice autopayment process contains pre-validation and payment processing phase at PSP. Pre-validation phase is where we check if all conditions are satisfied prior to making payment request to PSP. Some of pre-validations conditions are: Center’s config must have payment provider set Payment amount is greater than 0 Client’s payment card is not deleted Client’s payment card is not expired etc In case than any of these is violated, we abort the request preparation, return the response but we do not send failure email. Payment failure email will be sent in case that all pre-validations pass and something goes wrong during the processing of payment phase itself at PSP. Additional Information Please check in the client's Titan and Myregus account, if any of these conditions are matching or not - Center configuration can be checked under Titan> Admin> System Admin Payment amount can be checked in Invoice section on Titan and myregus Client credit card deletion emails, credit card expiry emails can be checked in Titan> Clients

Title: Meeting Room Fees not visible on Upcoming Invoice page on TeamHub
Search text: Meeting Room Fees not visible on Upcoming Invoice page on TeamHub On the Team Hub screen “View / Amend Upcoming Invoice”, we only show charges that are linked to bookings that are still active. So in cases like MR02 / MR01, where the associated meeting room booking has already ended (is in the past), Team Hub will intentionally not show those items anymore. What this means in practice If a charge is tied to a specific inventory (for example, a Meeting Room like MR02 / MR01) And the booking has already finished (checked out / expired) or has been cancelled Condition ( booking.EndDate >= DateTime.Today ) Then Team Hub treats it as no longer eligible to display in the “Upcoming Invoice” amend view Important: This does not mean the customer won’t be billed. The invoice can still be raised and the charges will still be applied - they just won’t appear in Team Hub’s “Upcoming Invoice” view once the booking is no longer active but they will be visible on the Previous Invoices page once it has been raised. Title: Customer made 2 bookings in the same day but did not get charged properly
Search text: Customer made 2 bookings in the same day but did not get charged properly If a Membership customer visits two locations on the same day how will this be charged? ► This will be considered as 2 days of use and deducted from their monthly allowance, or charged accordingly. EXAMPLE ONE: If a Membership customer makes the following bookings on the same day: Centre A: 9am -12pm Centre B: 1pm - 5pm T his means that 2x days will be deducted from their monthly allowance when making the bookings in their online account (or will be charged if they have exceeded their allowance). EXAMPLE TWO: If a Membership customer makes the following bookings on the same day, at the same time: Centre A: 9am -12pm Centre B: 9am -12pm This means the first booking will be deducted from their allowance, but the second booking at Centre B will be charged (as this indicates that a second person is using the single Membership and so should be subject to standard rates for a non-Member)Link here: https://iwg.learn.link/content/5f9048c1ee985a00106a3b00

Title: How Do I Get the Latest Version of TeamHub?
Search text: How Do I Get the Latest Version of TeamHub? Overview TeamHub updates are delivered differently depending on whether you are using a mobile device or a Windows desktop/laptop . Follow the steps below to ensure you always have the latest version installed. Mobile Devices (iOS and Android) To update TeamHub on your mobile phone or tablet: Simply go to your App Store (iOS) or Google Play Store (Android). If your version is not updating: Log out of TeamHub. Restart your device. This usually forces pending updates to install. Manual Update (If You Need the New Version Urgently) Follow these steps to install the latest version via the Microsoft Store: Click Start → search for Microsoft Store → open it. In the Store, search for TeamHub . Click Install (or Update , if available). Note TeamHub is compatible only with iOS, Android, or Windows 10 devices. It cannot be installed on Windows 7 devices.
